_comment: Canonical Prop Farm recipes — the known-good inputs for each prop so regenerating reproduces the same detail level (prompt drift was the cause of 'why did the mesh change'). prop_pull.py --name <key> loads this when --prompt is omitted. Note: even with identical inputs the GPU pipeline isn't bit-deterministic, but the DETAIL level is governed by the prompt+seed here.
_prompt_convention: Describe the SUBJECT + its real materials/colours ONLY (e.g. 'a table saw, cast-iron grey top, charcoal steel frame, orange motor, silver blade'). Do NOT add 'low poly', 'flat shading', 'Synty', etc. — the reference generator (gen_prop_ref_comfy.py) appends a fixed STYLE suffix with all of that to EVERY prompt automatically; repeating it only dilutes the subject tokens. The Synty look is centralised there (single knob, Windows-side); tune STYLE if you want it stronger, not these prompts.
_size_convention: height = real-world bbox height in metres (GLB ships true-sized → wire with prop(path,pos,yaw) scale 1.0). poly = painted pre-paint tri budget (set-dressing ~1500-2500, hero ~4000-6000).

tuning_bench.prompt: a sturdy wooden carpenter's workbench with a dark walnut top and four turned legs, a low back rack holding a row of upright slim silver steel rods, a black iron vise clamped to one end, and brass and chrome hand tools lying flat on the top

table_saw.prompt: a single complete woodworking table saw machine, one unit centered in frame: a flat cast-iron grey metal table top, a charcoal-black steel frame and four legs, a bright orange motor housing on the side, one silver circular saw blade above the table, a yellow rip-fence rail

organ.prompt: one tall pipe organ, a single instrument centered: a dark-walnut wood console with a cream and black keyboard, topped with a prominent bank of tall golden brass pipes, ornate brass trim

zip_tower.prompt: a tall outdoor zip-line launch tower, a square wooden timber frame with diagonal cross-braces, a railed platform deck on top, a steel ladder up one side, weathered grey timber and galvanised steel

zip_control_panel.prompt: a single outdoor control kiosk on a steel pedestal, a dark weatherproof metal box with a small glowing screen and a row of buttons

zip_release.prompt: a launch gate post: a single vertical steel post with a horizontal swing-arm gate bar and a red-and-green signal light on top

zip_winch.prompt: an industrial cable winch, a steel drum wound with cable on a yellow motor housing base

zip_trolley.prompt: a zip-line pulley trolley: two grooved metal wheels side by side gripping a horizontal cable at the top, a curved steel handlebar hanging below

warden_kiosk.prompt: a small outdoor warden ranger hut with a service-window counter and a shingled gable roof, timber walls with green-painted panels

hay_bale.prompt: a single round straw hay bale, cylindrical, tightly wrapped

clue_bag.prompt: a canvas duffel bag with buckled leather straps, closed, lying on its side

park_sign.prompt: a wooden park trail signpost, a single weathered timber post with two horizontal carved wooden arrow-shaped direction boards near the top pointing opposite ways, green painted lettering

trail_marker.prompt: a short carved wooden trail marker post, a single round-topped timber stake with a small painted arrow plaque

carousel.prompt: a carnival carousel merry-go-round, a round platform with a tall striped red-and-white conical canopy roof on a central pole, several colorful carved horses on golden poles spaced around it, gold scrollwork trim

photo_booth.prompt: a vintage carnival photo booth, a small enclosed wooden cabinet with a dark curtain doorway on the front, a striped awning top and a small lit sign

funhouse_facade.prompt: a carnival funhouse entrance kiosk, a brightly painted ornate front panel with a wide grinning clown-face doorway in the middle, round light bulbs around the edges

ticket_booth.prompt: a carnival ticket booth kiosk, a small ornate booth with an arched service window, a red-and-white striped awning, and a TICKETS sign board on top

prize_cabinet.prompt: a carnival prize cabinet, a tall glass-fronted display case on a wooden base, shelves of colorful stuffed-toy prizes inside, a striped top valance

poster_board.prompt: a carnival A-frame sandwich-board sign, two wooden boards hinged at the top standing like an easel, a blank poster panel on the front with a decorative scalloped header

signal_dish.prompt: a satellite communications dish on a tripod stand, a large white parabolic dish on a swiveling yoke mount atop three metal legs, a small feed arm at the dish center

drop_pod.prompt: a crashed cargo drop pod, a dented scorched metal capsule with a hinged side hatch and four stubby fins at the base, a tattered parachute harness bundled on top

supply_drone.prompt: a crashed quadcopter supply drone, four rotor arms with propellers around a boxy cargo body, landing skids, one rotor arm bent

pipe_rack.prompt: a tall wooden rack holding a row of upright organ pipes of varying heights, polished brass and grey pewter pipes in a timber frame stand

bellows_engine.prompt: a large workshop bellows blower engine, a big folded leather accordion bellows beside a cast-iron flywheel and piston on a riveted metal frame, a round brass pressure gauge

lumber_stack.prompt: a neat stack of sawn timber planks and wooden boards piled on the floor, a few offcuts on top

tool_board.prompt: a wall-mounted wooden pegboard tool rack with hand tools hanging on it - a saw, chisels, a mallet, clamps - a workshop tool board

mixing_console.prompt: a large recording studio mixing console, a wide angled desk covered in rows of faders and knobs with small meter lights, on a metal stand

patch_rack.prompt: a studio patch-bay rack cabinet, a tall black metal equipment rack full of patch points with a tangle of colorful patch cables down the front

reel_to_reel.prompt: a vintage reel-to-reel tape machine, two large round tape reels side by side above a control panel deck with VU meters and knobs

studio_monitor.prompt: a studio monitor speaker, a black angled floor wedge speaker cabinet with one large round driver and a small tweeter

amp_stack.prompt: a guitar amplifier stack, a large speaker cabinet with a separate head amp on top, black covering, a cloth grille and a row of control knobs
